name: Necho
overview: Necho, identified as the king of Egypt, plays a significant role in the events surrounding the kingdom of Judah during the reign of Josiah. Scripture records Necho's military campaign against Carchemish by the Euphrates, during which Josiah opposed him despite Necho's warning, resulting in Josiah's death at the battle of Megiddo. Furthermore, Necho exercised political authority over Judah by installing Eliakim as king, renaming him Jehoiakim, and taking Jehoahaz captive to Egypt, demonstrating his influence over the leadership of Judah.
